status: implemented teaching profiles; local functional acceptance complete through combined full-attempt and focused recovery evidence; historical performance exceptions remain; see phase audit

electronic-lamp.law: regulated input real power inside an explicit RMS operating band; zero-current off state outside it
electronic-lamp.parameterBasis: editable teaching assumptions; catalogue watts are electrical input; no manufacturer identity
electronic-lamp.parameters: 230 V nominal, 207-253 V operating band, 50/60 Hz AC terminal pair, ideal unity power factor, zero off/standby watts, non-dimmable
electronic-lamp.states: on, undervoltage-off, overvoltage-off, disconnected; unassessed waveform/dimming and nonconverged remain unavailable
electronic-lamp.example: single-phase source -> switch -> lamp L; lamp N -> source return; finite outgoing/return wires
electronic-lamp.acceptance: lamp-voltage-band, lamp-feeder-loss, lamp-series-parallel, lamp-invalid-supply, lamp-persistence, lamp-native-browser
electronic-lamp.missingData: manufacturer V-I curve, true/displacement PF and harmonics, startup/inrush, thermal/damage and dimmer compatibility are not supplied by catalogue labels

single-phase-motor.law: declared running R+jX equivalent at nominal voltage; I=V/Z, P=Re(V*conj(I)); no shaft-output conversion
single-phase-motor.parameterBasis: editable teaching assumptions; displayed watts require explicit electrical-input versus mechanical-nameplate provenance
single-phase-motor.parameters: 230 V, 50 Hz; proposed generic running displacement PF 0.8 lagging, 207-253 V operating band; no startup equivalent by default
single-phase-motor.states: running-equivalent inside band, outside-running-band with declared impedance current still calculated, switched-off; no shaft speed or startup inference
single-phase-motor.example: AC source -> switch -> motor L/N; PE remains a separate protective connection
single-phase-motor.missingData: actual winding/capacitor data, input/shaft power identity, efficiency, starting/stall current, torque/speed and regulator response require device data; no assumed efficiency

electronic-appliance.law: mode-selected regulated input-power branch; explicit standby and active demand
electronic-appliance.parameterBasis: editable teaching mode values; catalogue wattage is proposed active electrical demand, not a measured duty cycle
electronic-appliance.parameters: 230 V, 50/60 Hz, 207-253 V band; ideal unity PF teaching input; standby 1 W, off 0 W; active uses the recorded catalogue watts
electronic-appliance.states: off, standby, active; no automatic weather, user, protocol or sensor event
electronic-appliance.example: AC source -> protective contact -> appliance L/N/PE; explicit mode input
electronic-appliance.missingData: manufacturer mode consumption, displacement/distortion, external controller events, thermal cycles and protocol negotiations

composite-appliance.law: parallel internal branches selected by a declared mode: fixed heating resistance, running R+jX motor and regulated electronics; sum terminal complex currents
composite-appliance.parameterBasis: editable teaching allocation of the existing total watts; not a real appliance cycle or efficiency estimate
composite-appliance.parameters: 230 V, 50 Hz, 207-253 V running band; off 0 W, standby 1 W; heat uses total active watts as fixed R; motor mode uses total watts as electrical input at PF 0.8; combined mode allocates 80% heat and 20% motor
composite-appliance.states: off, standby, heating, motor, combined; user selects mode; no invented schedule
composite-appliance.example: AC source -> contact -> common appliance L/N; separate internal mode branches share terminal voltage
composite-appliance.missingData: actual branch allocation and sequence, motor input versus output, thermostat/cycle/environment inputs and temperature dependence

sounder.law: explicit silent/active mode with regulated active input power inside operating band
sounder.parameterBasis: generic 230 V AC teaching device because the existing catalogue has L/N terminals; not a claim that all bells/sirens are mains devices
sounder.parameters: 230 V, 50/60 Hz, 207-253 V, ideal unity PF; silent 0 W, active catalogue watts; default active for direct-wired bell/buzzer/siren
sounder.states: silent, active; wireless receiver defaults silent standby 1 W, test/chime selects active
sounder.example: AC source -> push button -> bell L; bell N -> return; receiver uses explicit test input
sounder.missingData: actual AC/DC/voltage suitability, coil/electronic input data, acoustic output and wireless events

alarm-electronics.law: regulated power per explicitly selected standby/alarm state
alarm-electronics.parameterBasis: editable teaching modes; not fire/security detection or certified alarm operation
alarm-electronics.parameters: 230 V, 50/60 Hz, 207-253 V, ideal unity PF; standby catalogue watts; alarm 2x catalogue watts; off 0 W; default standby
alarm-electronics.states: off, standby, test-alarm; no smoke/CO/intrusion event inferred from voltage
alarm-electronics.example: AC source -> alarm L/N with explicit Test alarm input; no invented backup battery
alarm-electronics.missingData: actual standby/alarm consumption, battery/charging model, interlink and sensor protocol

pv-source.law: piecewise-linear DC I-V source through (0,Isc), (Vmp,Imp), (Voc,0); solve network intersection, not fixed delivered watts
pv-source.parameterBasis: editable generic reference-condition teaching curve; 400 W = Vmp*Imp at reference conditions only
pv-source.parameters: reference 1000 W/m2 and 25 C; Voc 40 V, Isc 14 A, Vmp 32 V, Imp 12.5 A; explicit irradiance scales current; temperature coefficients default zero and labeled unmodeled
pv-source.states: illuminated, dark at zero irradiance, out-of-curve/reverse-bias unavailable until explicit extension
pv-source.example: PV DC+/DC- -> variable known resistor; test short, knee, open and darkness
pv-source.missingData: measured I-V curve, temperature coefficients, shading/bypass diodes, MPPT and inverter behaviour

autotransformer.law: ideal shared-common winding constraint V230/V110=230/110 with balanced input/output power; join both common terminals galvanically
autotransformer.parameterBasis: catalogue 110/230 V ratio and 1500 W capacity; ideal lossless winding is a teaching assumption
autotransformer.parameters: ports 0/2 are 110 V and 230 V taps, ports 1/3 share common; bidirectional AC; UI must label tap voltages before implementation
autotransformer.states: connected, open, conflicting tap/source or unsupported DC
autotransformer.example: 230 V across 230 tap/common -> 110 V tap/common resistive load; repeat reverse
autotransformer.missingData: winding impedance, magnetizing current, frequency band, thermal limit, saturation and protective operation

spd-shunt.law: declared piecewise shunt I(V)=V/Rleak + sign(V)*max(abs(V)-Vclamp,0)/Rdynamic; AC uses an explicitly labeled RMS envelope approximation
spd-shunt.parameterBasis: generic quasi-static teaching network; never infer clamping from Uc/Up or a Type 2 badge
spd-shunt.parameters: separate L-PE and N-PE branches; Rleak 1 Mohm, RMS-envelope Vclamp 300 V, Rdynamic 10 ohm; DC thresholds separately declared rather than converted from RMS
spd-shunt.states: leakage, conducting envelope, no PE return; no transient energy or destruction claim
spd-shunt.example: finite-impedance source L/N with explicit N-PE bond and SPD PE return; sweep terminal voltage
spd-shunt.missingData: actual SPD circuit topology, voltage/current curve, impulse waveform, charge/energy budget, disconnector and failure mode

ntc-resistance.law: R(T)=R25*exp(B*(1/(T+273.15)-1/298.15)); explicit temperature input; no self-heating inference
ntc-resistance.parameters: R25=10000 ohm, B=3950 K, temperature 25 C, declared temperature domain -40 to 125 C
ntc-resistance.states: valid temperature, out-of-domain/unconfigured; no ambient thermal dynamics
ntc-resistance.example: 12 V DC -> known resistor divider -> NTC; independently calculate divider voltage at 0/25/50 C
ntc-resistance.missingData: measured R-T curve, tolerance, dissipative/self-heating constant and response time

configured-three-phase.law: existing explicit balanced-resistive delta model; retain current independently accepted semantics
configured-three-phase.parameterBasis: existing state.motorModel teaching profile; catalogue 3000 W mechanical identity is not assumed to be input watts
configured-three-phase.parameters: setup offers editable 400 V line-line, explicit 3000 W electrical input teaching value, 50 Hz, ABC, 360-440 V band and existing unbalance setting
configured-three-phase.states: setup-required, configured running equivalent, phase/sequence/band blocked; retain existing guards
configured-three-phase.example: three-phase source -> existing DOL contactor -> configured U/V/W motor
configured-three-phase.missingData: actual motor input power, reactive current, efficiency, shaft output, torque/speed, starting/stall and thermal data
